message.content:
Wool-blend shawl-collar blazer, relaxed oversized cut, knee-length hem, deep olive green (#4B5320), textured heavy weave.
Ribbed knit midi sweater, crew neck with dropped shoulders, hip-length fit, warm burgundy (#800020), soft cotton-polyester blend.
Straight-leg dark denim trousers, mid-rise waist, ankle-length hem, indigo wash (#191970), rigid cotton twill.
Leather slide sandals, flat sole with slight platform, strappy design, tan leather (#D2B48C).
Silk-voile oversized tote bag, open top with drawstring closure, neutral beige (#F5F5DC) with leather trim.
This ensemble bridges the gap between beach leisure and evening elegance for a seaside vacation in autumn. The structured yet casual blazer provides warmth against the cool evening air while maintaining a relaxed travel vibe. Rich earth tones like olive green and burgundy complement the natural coastal backdrop and artificial waterfront lighting. The outfit respects her wish for neat attire without crossing into formal territory, ensuring comfort for both daytime beach walks and dinner by the shore.
